sections.bio:
Product evangelist. Growth Mindset. Servant Leader. 
Worked in 11 startups, scaleups and unicorns across DE, US and Japan.
Grew communities from 0-30,000 /50,000 Users. 
Helped grew startup 0 to 100k in transaction volume. 

Product/UX & designer with +8 years multidisciplinary experience. Entrepreneur. Certified Scrum Master. SAFe framework.  Won several prizes as Startup. 3 Accelerator programs: Startup school from Y-Combinator, SIBB and zen launchpad.

Worked for: Zalando (ZLabels), Sahinler group (Santex), Policy lead & Lustre Life. 

Enthusiastic about product management in: Digital health, Wearable tech, Blockchain, E-commerce and social media.

Mentoring from time to time at The mentors club &  at MentorCruise.

posts.text:
Exciting milestone!

In just 5 weeks, MindNote has sold $12,215 on Artizen.

Building this as a solo side project has been an incredible journey, and I'm grateful for everyone who has supported it so far.

If you'd like to support MindNote, you can purchase any of the artifacts or subscription bundles, or simply help spread the word by sharing this post:

https://lnkd.in/eBJitDhm

Thank you for being part of the journey! ❤️

Building MindNote has taught me something unexpected.
The most valuable insights rarely come from a single conversation, meeting, or note.
They emerge when ideas from different moments connect.
Recently, two notes taken weeks apart surfaced together and revealed a pattern that wasn't visible before.
That's when it clicked:
AI isn't just an answer engine.
It's recognizing patterns, connecting ideas, and surfacing insights at the right moment.
And that's the part of the future that excites me most.

MindNote just passed 1,000 installs only on Android. Wouhou!

When I started building it, I honestly assumed B2B would be the easier path: Sell it to teams, close deals, move on.

Reality has been a bit different.

It turns out the strongest signal hasn’t come from “sales conversations”… it’s been from individual users (students, researchers) and entrepreneurs who discovered the product through campaigns or social media, subscribed, and are finding value in it day to day.

That shift has been important.

At the same time, MindNote has always been built for both B2B and B2C, there’s no need to choose one over the other. The goal is simple: make AI notetaking useful whether you’re a solo user, student, researcher, founder, or a full team.

Right now, I’m running a pilot program with startups and early teams to understand how MindNote fits into real workflows meetings, ideas, decisions, follow-ups.

If you’re a startup or team that wants to try it out and give feedback, I’m opening a few pilot spots.

Just send me a DM.

Another way to support MindNote is by helping spread the word about the pilot program.

Thanks! 👌
